context_for_next_testing_agent: Driver login bug (whitespace root cause) is fully fixed and verified. Backend normalizes phone via re.sub(r'\s+','',...) in /api/driver/auth/login and /api/rental-admin/drivers create. Frontend strips whitespace in DriverLogin.jsx before login(). Use +91 90000 00001 (with spaces) as regression case.
rca of the issue: Root cause: seeded phones stored as '+919000000001' (no spaces) but placeholder '+91 90000 00000' encouraged users to type with spaces, producing 401. Fix: strip \s+ at both frontend submit boundary and backend login/create endpoints. Verified via curl (spaced phone -> 200) and UI (spaced phone -> Raj Kumar Home).
